2609.01111.title: ClinTraceBench: Source-Verifiable Longitudinal Clinical Reasoning over EHR-Derived Dialogues
2609.01111.paper_summary: Clinical LLM assistants must reason over multi-visit patient trajectories, yet whether the compact history representations used to scale them---retrieval, structured timelines, LLM summaries, agentic memory---preserve the longitudinal signal clinical reasoning needs has not been measured. We introduce ClinTraceBench: 385 MIMIC-IV-derived verified dialogues with event-ID provenance, a nine-task taxonomy (T1--T9), and L0--L4 deterministic + L5 human-audit validation (98.92\% agreement). We evaluate eight history representation strategies---a no-context floor, \textit{last-visit-only}, \textit{full-context}, BGE-M3 \textit{dense-retrieval}, two compression schemes, and two agentic-memory systems (\textit{Mem0}, \textit{A-Mem})---across four backbones (DeepSeek-V3, GPT-4o-mini, Haiku~4.5, Sonnet~4.6) on 6{,}271 questions: 32 cells, 200{,}672 predictions. Four findings: (SP4) a controlled T3 injection probe isolates compression-induced \textit{relation} loss---with the attribution sentence present \textit{before} construction, \textit{Mem0}, \textit{A-Mem} and \textit{llm-summary} still recover only 0--5.3\% of the injected positives; (SP1) compressed strategies pay an aggregation tax on multi-visit trends and cross-patient comparisons; (SP2) the blind-to-full gap spans $+29.8$~pp (GPT-4o-mini) to $+62.7$~pp (Haiku); (SP3) abstention scales non-monotonically with context length. On the Pareto frontier Haiku dominates Sonnet under \textit{full-context} (\$25.76 vs.\ \$106.21), inverting the ``biggest backbone wins'' heuristic.
2609.01111.paper_summary_zh: 臨床 LLM 助手必須對多次就診的病人軌跡進行推理，然而用於擴展它們的緊湊歷史表示——檢索、結構化時間線、LLM 摘要、代理記憶——是否保留了臨床推理所需的縱向信號尚未被測量。我們介紹了 ClinTraceBench：385 個來自 MIMIC-IV 的經過驗證的對話，具有事件 ID 來源，一個九任務分類法（T1--T9），以及 L0--L4 確定性 + L5 人工審核驗證（98.92\% 一致性）。我們評估了八種歷史表示策略——無上下文基準、\textit{僅最後一次就診}、\textit{完整上下文}、BGE-M3 \textit{密集檢索}、兩種壓縮方案和兩種代理記憶系統（\textit{Mem0}、\textit{A-Mem}）——在四個骨幹（DeepSeek-V3、GPT-4o-mini、Haiku~4.5、Sonnet~4.6）上進行 6{,}271 個問題的評估：32 個單元，200{,}672 次預測。四個發現：（SP4）一個受控的 T3 注入探針隔離了壓縮引起的 \textit{關係}損失——在構建之前存在的歸因句子中，\textit{Mem0}、\textit{A-Mem} 和 \textit{llm-summary} 仍然僅恢復 0--5.3\% 的注入陽性；（SP1）壓縮策略對多次就診趨勢和跨病人比較支付了聚合稅；（SP2）盲目到完整的差距範圍從 $+29.8$~pp（GPT-4o-mini）到 $+62.7$~pp（Haiku）；（SP3）棄權與上下文長度的關係非單調地擴展。在 Pareto 邊界上，Haiku 在 \textit{完整上下文} 下優於 Sonnet（\$25.76 對 \$106.21），顛覆了「最大的骨幹贏」的啟發式。
